scenes.dialogue_en: He rolled back the small mat.

es: El aire fresco le revolvió las púas. Tal vez pudiera pasar.

es: Bajó la nariz. Al otro lado de la abertura, unas raíces claras se curvaban bajo la tierra.

es: Primero la nariz. Luego las patas delanteras. PinPin se deslizó con cuidado entre las raíces.

es: Se agachó bien. Sus púas rozaron la raíz y, por fin, pasó.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin looked back. A little patch of the warm room still shone behind him.

es: PinPin miró atrás. Todavía veía un pedacito de la habitación cálida y luminosa.

es: El suelo bajaba suavemente. Apoyó una patita y luego la otra, sintiendo la tierra bajo sus pies.

scenes.dialogue_en: Around a pale stone, he saw a thin seam of light. The passage was opening out.

es: Al rodear una piedra clara, vio una rayita de luz. El pasadizo se ensanchaba.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin slipped out between the rocks onto a broad stone floor.

es: PinPin salió entre las rocas a un amplio suelo de piedra.

scenes.dialogue_en: He stood very still. The cave rose high above him. There were pictures on the walls.

ru: Он замер. Пещера поднималась высоко над ним. На стенах были картины.
es: Se quedó muy quieto. La cueva se alzaba muy por encima de él. Había pinturas en las paredes.

scenes.dialogue_en: A woman in a long dress looked out from one wall. Beside her were a baby and growing plants.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; PinPin alone until Elder appears in40. Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

es: Desde una pared lo miraba una mujer con un vestido largo. A su lado había un bebé y plantas que crecían.

scenes.dialogue_en: Scritch. A little sound came from the passage behind him.

es: Ras. Un ruidito llegó del pasadizo, detrás de él.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin drew his paws close. “Who’s there?”

scenes.dialogue_en: “Only me.” Round spectacles appeared between the roots. It was the Elder.

es: «Soy yo». Entre las raíces aparecieron unas gafas redondas. Era el anciano.

scenes.dialogue_en: “You surprised me!” said PinPin. “And you surprised me,” said the Elder, with a little smile.

en: “You surprised me!” said PinPin. “And you surprised me,” said the Elder, with a little smile.
ru: «Ты меня удивил!» — сказал Пин-Пин. «И ты меня», — ответил Старейшина с лёгкой улыбкой.
es: «¡Me sorprendiste!», dijo PinPin. «Y tú a mí», dijo el anciano con una pequeña sonrisa.

scenes.dialogue_en: “How did you find me?” “I woke up and saw the moved mat. Then I followed your little paw marks.”

en: “How did you find me?” “I woke up and saw the moved mat. Then I followed your little paw marks.”
ru: «Как ты меня нашёл?» «Я проснулся и увидел сдвинутый коврик. А потом пошёл по следам твоих лапок».
es: «¿Cómo me encontraste?» «Me desperté y vi la alfombrita movida. Después seguí las huellas de tus patitas».

scenes.dialogue_en: “Who made this place?” “Humans,” said the Elder. “They painted these stories long ago. Some still come here.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “Who made all this?” “Humans,” said the Elder. “They made this place for their gods.”

es: «¿Quién hizo todo esto?» «Los humanos», dijo el anciano. «Hicieron este lugar para sus dioses».

scenes.dialogue_en: “Who lights the lamps?” “People who care for this place. They help protect our forest, too.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “And the lamps?” “The people who care for this place light them. They look after our forest, too.”
ru: «А лампы?» «Их зажигают люди, которые заботятся об этом месте. Они заботятся и о нашем лесе».
es: «¿Y las lámparas?» «Las encienden las personas que cuidan este lugar. También cuidan nuestro bosque».

scenes.dialogue_en: “The painted people look like them!” “Yes,” said the Elder. “They gave the pictures faces like their own.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “Their gods look like them!” “Yes. That is how they painted them.”

es: «¡Sus dioses se parecen a ellos!» «Sí. Así los pintaron».

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin looked at the woman’s round belly. “Is there a baby inside?” “Yes. They call her the Mother of Life.”

en: PinPin looked at the woman’s round belly. “Is there a baby inside?” “Yes. She is the Mother of Life.”

es: PinPin miró la barriga redonda de la mujer. «¿Hay un bebé dentro?» «Sí. Es la Madre de la Vida».

scenes.dialogue_en: “Like PomPom, before he was born?” “Just like that,” said the Elder. “And look beside her—little seeds are growing.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “Is she a goddess?” “A goddess of fertility. New life: babies being born, and seeds growing into food.”
ru: «Она богиня?» «Богиня плодородия — новой жизни. Когда рождаются малыши, а из семян вырастает еда».
es: «¿Es una diosa?» «Una diosa de la fertilidad. De la vida nueva: los bebés que nacen y las semillas que crecen y nos dan comida».

altOverride.en: PinPin and the Elder speak before the Mother of Life painting.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin found the painted baby. Then the little green shoots. “Both need looking after.”

en: PinPin found the painted baby. Then the little green shoots. “Both need looking after.”

es: PinPin encontró al bebé pintado. Luego, los brotecitos verdes. «Todos necesitan cuidados».

scenes.dialogue_en: “Why are there real seeds here?” “Someone left them with a wish, or a thank-you,” said the Elder, softly.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “Why are there seeds here?” “People leave them when they pray. They ask the goddess for help, or say thank you.”
ru: «Почему здесь семена?» «Люди оставляют их, когда молятся. Просят богиню о помощи или говорят ей спасибо».
es: «¿Por qué hay semillas aquí?» «Las personas las dejan cuando rezan. Piden ayuda a la diosa o le dan las gracias».

scenes.dialogue_en: “And then?” “Then they went home to care for their babies and gardens.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “And then?” “Then they go home and care for their babies and gardens.”
ru: «А потом?» «Потом идут домой и заботятся о своих малышах и садах».
es: «¿Y después?» «Después vuelven a casa y cuidan a sus bebés y sus huertos».

scenes.dialogue_en: On the next wall was a strong man with a great shield. Little homes stood behind him.

en: On the next wall was a strong man with a great shield. Little homes stood behind him.

es: En la siguiente pared había un hombre fuerte con un gran escudo. Detrás de él se veían casitas.

scenes.dialogue_en: “Who is he?” “The Shield Keeper. Look behind his shield.”

es: «¿Quién es?» «El Guardián del Escudo. Un dios de la guerra. Mira lo que protege».

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin found the little families. “He’s keeping the danger away from them.”

es: PinPin miró a las pequeñas familias. «Las protege del peligro».

scenes.dialogue_en: “Yes,” said the Elder. “He stands between them and harm.” PinPin moved a little closer.

en: “Yes,” said the Elder. “Here in the picture, he stands between them and harm.” PinPin moved a little closer.

es: «Sí», dijo el anciano. «En esta pintura, se pone entre ellas y el peligro». PinPin se acercó un poquito.

scenes.dialogue_en: Another picture showed sunlight, green trees and a great cold darkness. A little house stood between them.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: Another picture showed sunlight, green trees and a great cold darkness. A little house stood between them.

es: Otra pintura mostraba la luz del sol, árboles verdes y una gran oscuridad fría. Entre ellos había una casita.

scenes.dialogue_en: “But I like night,” said PinPin. “Mama tucks me in.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “But I like night,” said PinPin. “Mama tucks me in.”

es: «Pero a mí me gusta la noche», dijo PinPin. «Mamá me arropa».

scenes.dialogue_en: “So do I,” said the Elder. “Night gives us rest. In this picture, the cold storm threatens the little homes.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “So do I,” said the Elder. “Night gives us rest. In this picture, the cold storm threatens the little homes.”
ru: «И я люблю, — сказал Старейшина. — Ночью мы отдыхаем. А на этой картине маленьким домикам грозит холодная буря».
es: «A mí también», dijo el anciano. «La noche nos deja descansar. En esta pintura, la tormenta fría amenaza a las casitas».

scenes.dialogue_en: “They painted animals too!” PinPin found paws carrying wood, bringing food and holding little ones.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “They painted animals too!” PinPin found paws carrying wood, bringing food and holding little ones.

es: «¡También pintaron animales!» PinPin encontró patas que llevaban leña, traían comida y sostenían a los pequeños.

scenes.dialogue_en: “Can the Shield Keeper do all those jobs?” “No,” said the Elder. “No one can.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “Can the Shield Keeper do all those jobs?” “No,” said the Elder. “No one can.”
ru: «Хранитель Щита может всё это делать?» «Нет, — сказал Старейшина. — Никто не может всё один».
es: «¿El Guardián del Escudo puede hacer todos esos trabajos?» «No», dijo el anciano. «Nadie puede».

scenes.dialogue_en: “Some carry wood. Some bring food. Some hold the little ones,” said the Elder. “They help one another.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “A strong arm can hold a shield. Other paws grow food and build warm homes. They need one another.”
ru: «Сильная рука держит щит. Другие лапки выращивают еду и строят тёплые дома. Они нужны друг другу».
es: «Un brazo fuerte puede sostener un escudo. Otras patas cultivan comida y construyen hogares cálidos. Se necesitan unos a otros».

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin looked once more at the mother, the shield, and the little homes. There was so much to remember.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: PinPin thought of the lake, the little plant, and the homes on the map.

es: PinPin pensó en el lago, la plantita y las casas del mapa.

scenes.dialogue_en: “Back through there?” asked PinPin. “The same way,” said the Elder. “I’m right behind you.”

es: «¿Volvemos por ahí?», preguntó PinPin. «Por el mismo camino», dijo el anciano. «Voy justo detrás de ti».

es: PinPin se agachó para entrar en el pasadizo bajo. El anciano se inclinó para seguirlo.

es: Junto a la raíz dividida, PinPin se detuvo y miró atrás. El anciano estaba allí.

scenes.dialogue_en: Ahead was the little patch of home. PinPin could smell paper and warm wood again.

en: Ahead was the little patch of home. PinPin could smell paper and warm wood again.
ru: Впереди виднелся кусочек дома. Пин-Пин снова почувствовал запах бумаги и тёплого дерева.
es: Delante se veía un pedacito de la casa. PinPin volvía a oler el papel y la madera cálida.

scenes.dialogue_en: He squeezed through. His front paws found the floor; then came his back feet.

en: He squeezed through. His front paws found the floor; then came his back feet.
ru: Он протиснулся наружу. Сначала пола коснулись передние лапки, потом задние.
es: Pasó por la abertura. Sus patas delanteras tocaron el suelo; después salieron las traseras.

scenes.dialogue_en: The Elder crouched low and wriggled through after him. A dry leaf clung to his quills.

en: The Elder crouched low and wriggled through after him. A dry leaf clung to his quills.
ru: Старейшина пригнулся и протиснулся следом. За его иголки зацепился сухой лист.
es: El anciano se agachó y pasó detrás de él. Una hoja seca quedó enganchada en sus púas.

scenes.dialogue_en: “You brought something back,” said PinPin. He lifted the leaf away. They both smiled.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “You brought something back,” said PinPin. He lifted the leaf away. They both smiled.
ru: «Ты кое-что принёс», — сказал Пин-Пин и снял лист. Оба улыбнулись.
es: «Te has traído algo», dijo PinPin. Le quitó la hoja. Los dos sonrieron.

scenes.dialogue_en: Together they brushed the loose earth back beside the roots.

en: Together they brushed the loose earth back beside the roots.
ru: Вместе они подгребли рыхлую землю обратно к корням.
es: Juntos volvieron a arrimar la tierra suelta a las raíces.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin unrolled the small mat against the roots. The cool draft softened.

en: PinPin unrolled the small mat against the roots. The cool draft softened.
ru: Пин-Пин развернул маленький коврик у корней. Прохладой стало тянуть меньше.
es: PinPin desenrolló la alfombrita junto a las raíces. La corriente de aire fresco se suavizó.

scenes.dialogue_en: They slid the little footstool back. The book was still open at their page.
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: They slid the little footstool back. The book was still open at their page.
ru: Они подвинули скамеечку на место. Книга всё ещё была открыта на той же странице.
es: Volvieron a poner el taburete en su sitio. El libro seguía abierto por la misma página.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin looked at the open book. “Will you teach me to read and write?”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “Your quill carries old magic from our ancestors,” said the Elder. “There is still much to learn. We will take our time.”
ru: «В твоей иголке — древнее волшебство наших предков, — сказал Старейшина. — Нам ещё многое предстоит узнать. Не будем спешить».
es: «Tu púa guarda una magia antigua de nuestros antepasados», dijo el anciano. «Aún queda mucho por aprender. Iremos sin prisa».

scenes.dialogue_en: “I would be glad to,” said the Elder. “We’ll begin with your name, one letter at a time. Papa can bring you again.”
scenes.continuity: Retain selected revision03 physical action and object state. Same first visit; Follow the root-route/prop states in bible.md; visible selected image review below.

en: “What shall I write?” asked the Elder. “How can my magic help?” said PinPin.
ru: «Что мне записать?» — спросил Старейшина. «Как моё волшебство может помочь?» — сказал Пин-Пин.
es: «¿Qué escribo?», preguntó el anciano. «¿Cómo puede ayudar mi magia?», dijo PinPin.

altOverride.en: The Elder writes at his desk while PinPin watches.
altOverride.ru: Старейшина пишет за своим столом, а Пин-Пин наблюдает.
altOverride.es: El anciano escribe en su escritorio mientras PinPin observa.

scenes.dialogue_en: Outside, Papa was awake. Scooby lifted his head when PinPin came through the doorway.
scenes.shot: Whole coherent Elder exterior: child and Elder emerge, Papa seated on established sun patch, dog raises head.
scenes.continuity: Same Papa/dog rest position and plant now freed; crooked staff parked until used; bright daytime.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin ran into Papa’s arms. “I found pictures under the ground! And the Elder is going to help me read!”
scenes.shot: Papa crouches embraces child; Elder nearby smiling; Scooby can be at edge.
scenes.continuity: Family openness, no secret pact or magic lesson; happy mild wonder.

scenes.dialogue_en: “Then we’ll come back,” said Papa. “Thank you, old friend.” The Elder smiled. “Bring your questions.”
scenes.shot: Papa and Elder reciprocal farewell, child between but lower; dog waiting by departure stone.
scenes.continuity: No next-dawn/private appointment; adult-inclusive future visits, no chosen-one payoff.

scenes.dialogue_en: Scooby crouched beside the flat stone. Papa helped PinPin climb up again.
scenes.shot: Child transfers stone to dog with grounded Papa support.
scenes.continuity: Repeat established safe boarding: child front; dog stationary crouched; no sudden fully-mounted cut.

scenes.dialogue_en: Papa settled behind him. Scooby rose slowly, and PinPin gave the Elder a little wave.
scenes.shot: Mounted trio upright before departure, Papa supporting child as one child paw waves.
scenes.continuity: One child paw on fur, Papa arm supports torso; Elder beside root doorway; dog four paws.

scenes.dialogue_en: They walked home through the bright woods. PinPin leaned against Papa and watched the leaves go by.
scenes.shot: Side-three-quarter gentle walking with same riders; bright late morning.
scenes.continuity: No nap on unsecured dog; Papa supports relaxed awake child; no sunset.

scenes.dialogue_en: Soon the green door of home came into view. Scooby knew just where to stop.
scenes.shot: Approach established cottage and garden stone.
scenes.continuity: Cottage geometry preserved; Papa/child positions unchanged, Mama/baby still home.

scenes.dialogue_en: Scooby crouched. Papa stepped onto the stone, keeping a paw close to PinPin.
scenes.shot: Papa stands on mounting stone after dismount, child still seated; dog crouched.
scenes.continuity: Exact same stable crouch/dismount mechanics, no rider teleport.

scenes.dialogue_en: Then he helped PinPin onto the stone. Mama opened the door. “Just in time!”
scenes.shot: Papa supporting child down, Mama holds baby in doorway.
scenes.continuity: Four family members, dog outside; infant never loose/standing.

scenes.dialogue_en: Papa filled Scooby’s water bowl. PinPin gave the little dog a gentle pat. “Thank you for the ride.”
scenes.shot: Outside care: Papa pouring bowl, grounded child pats shoulder, dog stands or lies naturally.
scenes.continuity: No human meal fed to dog; bowl established morning spot; Scooby remains outdoors.

scenes.dialogue_en: Inside, PinPin washed his dusty paws. Mama had made a warm lunch.
scenes.shot: PinPin washing at established child-height basin; Mama and supported baby if visible.
scenes.continuity: Root-discovery dirt washed before eating; no unsupervised baby or unsafe height.

scenes.dialogue_en: They sat down together: Mama, Papa, PinPin and little PomPom. Sunlight lay across the table.
scenes.shot: Daytime family lunch wide, four hedgehogs; baby supported in Mama arm, others proper seats.
scenes.continuity: Same meal room and table as breakfast, lunch food changes; sunshine midday not evening.

scenes.dialogue_en: “Tell us about your morning,” said Mama. Papa passed PinPin the bread. PomPom reached for Mama’s paw.
scenes.shot: Family meal closer: Mama listens, Papa passes bread, baby holds/reaches her paw.
scenes.continuity: Concrete separate paw contacts, no extra arms; baby only supported, not eating unsuitable food.

scenes.dialogue_en: PinPin smiled. “First, a page moved all by itself…” And, between mouthfuls, he began his story.
scenes.shot: Final warm family listening composition; child tells story at table, all four readable.
scenes.continuity: Happy daytime home conclusion; no magical effect or implied spell shown, page movement already draft-caused.
